column3: Human day is rendered as “human court.”
Being conscious of nothing against oneself is rendered as “My conscience is clear.”
“Go beyond” supplies a verb in the quoted elliptical phrase.
Being filled is rendered as having all one wants; reigning is rendered as becoming kings.
Entreating is rendered as answering gently.
Begetting is rendered as becoming father.
Not the word but the power is rendered as “not only” the words but the power.
